presets.name: Flat
presets.description: All bands set to zero for neutral and unaltered sound.

presets.name: Normal
presets.description: Gentle lift at both ends with restrained mids.

presets.name: Classical
presets.description: Hall warmth, honest mids, softer presence, and extended air.

presets.name: Dance
presets.description: Strong 60 Hz drive with a mid scoop and light top-end energy.

presets.name: Heavy Metal
presets.description: Kick and guitar body, less mud, and more pick attack.

presets.name: Hip Hop
presets.description: Deep bass emphasis with cleaner low mids and light treble definition.

presets.name: Jazz
presets.description: Warm and intimate with restrained presence and air.

presets.name: Pop
presets.description: Tight lows, reduced congestion, and forward vocal presence.

presets.name: Rock
presets.description: Punch at 60–125 Hz, a mud cut, and guitar attack around 4–8 kHz.

presets.name: Acoustic
presets.description: Natural body with less boxiness and more string detail.

presets.name: Vocal Boost
presets.description: Cuts rumble and raises the 1–4 kHz intelligibility region.

presets.name: Bass Boost
presets.description: Centers the lift near audible 60–125 Hz bass while preserving headroom elsewhere.

presets.name: Treble Boost
presets.description: Peaks around 8 kHz instead of wasting the largest boost at 16 kHz.

presets.name: Deep House
presets.description: Sub-bass and bass weight with a broad low-mid reduction.

presets.name: EDM
presets.description: Bass impact, reduced low-mid masking, and a gentle presence lift.

presets.name: R&B
presets.description: Low-end warmth with clean mids and a smooth high-frequency lift.

presets.name: Dream
presets.description: Intentionally dark and lush, with elevated bass and veiled treble.

presets.name: Podcast
presets.description: Drops rumble and boxiness while raising speech intelligibility.

presets.name: Reggae
presets.description: Strong bass foundation with relaxed mids and modest presence.

presets.name: Country
presets.description: Reduced sub-bass, natural body, and clear vocal/string presence.

presets.name: K-Pop
presets.description: Tight bass, clean lower mids, and polished vocal presence.

presets.name: Small Speakers
presets.description: Optimized for small speakers with enhanced presence and controlled bass.

presets.name: Full Bass
presets.description: Powerful low-end boost with controlled mids and treble.

presets.name: Full Treble
presets.description: Strong high-frequency boost for a brighter and more detailed sound.
